I can’t say the image was created — the image-generation service is currently unavailable and I won’t represent that an action completed when it didn’t. I can’t run background checks or create the file while the tool is offline. I can, however, provide everything you need so you can reproduce the banner immediately (or I can generate it for you once the image service is available).

Below are ready-to-use assets and instructions. Tell me which option you want next.

1) Ready-to-run image-generator prompt (adjust size/style as needed)
- Prompt (for an AI image tool): "Wide website banner, 1920x480 px, modern professional style. Background: soft navy-to-teal diagonal gradient. Left side: abstract geometric shapes in semi-transparent white and light teal. Right side: high-contrast focal area with large headline text 'Your Company — Accelerating Growth' in bold sans-serif, secondary line 'Solutions for modern teams' in medium weight. Include subtle light flare near top-right, and space for a logo at top-left (transparent area). Color palette: #042A40 (navy), #007A7A (teal), #00C2B2 (accent), white. Overall mood: confident, clean, optimistic. Render crisp vector-like shapes, clean typography, 300 dpi, export as PNG with transparent logo area and an additional JPG export. Include 16:4 cropping safe margins, avoid small fine text in the background."

2) Design specs (for a human designer or Canva/Photoshop)
- Canvas: 1920 x 480 px (export also at 2x for Retina: 3840 x 960 px)
- Color palette: navy #042A40, teal #007A7A, accent #00C2B2, white #FFFFFF
- Fonts: Headline — Montserrat Bold; Subhead — Montserrat Medium
- Headline size suggestion: 72–96 px (desktop); Subhead: 28–36 px
- Logo area: 200 x 80 px top-left, leave transparent padding 24 px
- Safe text margin: 120 px from left/right edges
- File exports: PNG-24 (transparent logo area), JPG high quality (for faster loading), SVG for vector elements if you want scalability
- Suggested filename conventions: banner_homepage_v1.png, banner_homepage_v1@2x.png, banner_homepage_v1.jpg

3) Step-by-step to create quickly in Canva/Photoshop
- Create new file 1920 x 480 px (or 3840 x 960 px for high-res)
- Add diagonal gradient background (navy -> teal)
- Place geometric shapes (opacity 15–30%) on left third
- Add headline text on right third; choose bold sans-serif, set contrast to white
- Reserve an empty box top-left for the logo (or place your logo)
- Apply subtle overlay/flare and export PNG and JPG

4) Accessibility and web-ready tips
- Provide alt text: "Banner with abstract geometric shapes and headline 'Your Company — Accelerating Growth'."
- Ensure contrast ratio for headline meets WCAG (white on dark gradient should pass)
- Use responsive CSS: background-size: cover; background-position: center; and serve @2x images for high-DPI

If you want, I can:
- Customize the prompt or specs to your exact brand colors, logo, and text
- Produce alternative sizes (mobile/tablet)
- Generate an SVG layout you can edit locally (I can provide SVG code now if that helps)

Which would you like me to do now?
